_info: Stock (standard) configuration of ONE engine, loaded automatically when this engine is selected and by the button 'Load stock configuration'. File name = engine id. 'chargers': a catalog id (string) or {"profile": {...}, "count": n} for a part that belongs to this engine only. Maps use the shared rpm axis [800,2000,3500,5000,6000,7000] and load axis [0,25,50,75,100] ([loadIdx][rpmIdx]). 'reference' holds a known factory power figure for later calibration.
name: Mazda 13B-MSP Renesis (2-rotor Wankel) - stock configuration
generated: ignition and fuel maps derived from the shared base maps: rpm axis stretched to this engine's redline, fuel scaled by displacement per cylinder, ignition for a naturally aspirated engine (low-load row, 0.1 deg retard per % load)

reference.standard: Manufacturer rating in PS as published for the high-output version, converted to mechanical hp with 1 hp = 1.01387 PS
reference.variant: RX-8 13B-MSP high-output version, 2 x 654 cc, 10.0:1, manual transmission
reference.source: australiancar.reviews Mazda 13B-MSP (654 cc per rotor, 10.0:1); dailydriven.ro (192-250 PS, 10.0:1); foxed.ca RX-8 service manual (654 x 2 cc, 10.0:1); carinterior.alibaba.com (redline 9000 rpm)
reference.notes: Rotor geometry (generating radius 105 mm, eccentricity 15 mm, width 80 mm) gives 654.7 cc per chamber by V = 3*sqrt(3)*e*R*b and matches the published 654 cc. The 250 PS peak speed of 8500 rpm and the 9000 rpm redline are the commonly published values; the 9300 rpm limiter, oil mass, rotating mass and inertia are estimates. No torque figure was confirmed in the sources searched, so none is stored.
